name: Adobe Photoshop CC 2021 (v22)
summary: Runs for everyday editing through Wine; GPU features, Neural Filters and Creative Cloud sign-in do not work.
notes:
Photoshop 2021 (22.x) is the last release that runs acceptably through Wine; 2022+ (v23/v24) crash or fail to install - use the 2021 build. You need the standalone (offline) Photoshop 2021 installer and a licence you already own; the Creative Cloud desktop app itself does NOT run, so 'Sign in', Creative Cloud sync and Adobe Fonts are unavailable.
After installing: Edit > Preferences > Performance > untick 'Use Graphics Processor' (GPU acceleration, Neural Filters, 3D and some blur/lens filters need DirectX/OpenCL features Wine cannot provide). Camera Raw works in CPU mode. Large files and Liquify are slower than on Windows.
This recipe creates a 64-bit C:\ drive with the runtimes Photoshop expects (Visual C++ 2019, GDI+, ATM, MSXML, core fonts, RGB font smoothing) and sets Windows 10 as the reported version. It also works inside Bottles (Creator mode) with the same winetricks verbs.
Native alternatives on Lindos: GIMP, Krita (painting), Photopea (web, PSD compatible).
installer_hint: Set-up.exe from the standalone Photoshop 2021 package: lindos-run --prefix photoshop-cc-2021 ~/Downloads/Set-up.exe

alternatives.name: GIMP
alternatives.how: native, free: Lindos Settings > Apps > Store, or: apt install gimp

alternatives.name: Krita
alternatives.how: native painting/illustration: apt install krita (or Flatpak org.kde.krita)
